exposure: Sleep disorders (measured by Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index)
cohort: The participants included 122 healthy singleton pregnant women.
finding: Sleep disorders at 16 weeks of gestation were the most significantly associated with threatened premature delivery.
cross-section timing: Sleep quality was evaluated at initial examination and at 16, 24, and 32 weeks of gestation.
gest_age: Outcomes were defined as occurring before 37 weeks of gestation; sleep quality was assessed throughout gestation at various time points.
